action.en: Cucumber plants produce separate male and female flowers on the same plant. Male flowers commonly appear first; female flowers have a small ovary behind the bloom and need pollen transfer for fruit development. Early flower drop alone is therefore not proof of a plant problem.

action.en: In cucumber, male flowers often appear before female flowers. The small swelling behind a female flower is the developing ovary; pollen transfer is needed for fruit development in the typical varieties described by UMN Extension. The first male flowers dropping is normal.

Es normal que caigan las primeras flores masculinas.

context.en: The source describes cutting the central head and leaving the plant for side shoots; presenting this under management is an editorial placement, not a separate pruning protocol.

action.en: The cited guidance does not prescribe routine pruning. Cut the mature central head with a short stalk and leave the lower plant in place so secondary shoots may develop; this is a harvest cut, not a canopy-shaping regimen.
action.es: La fuente no prescribe poda rutinaria. Corta la cabeza central madura con un tramo corto de tallo y deja la parte inferior de la planta para que puedan desarrollarse brotes secundarios; es un corte de cosecha, no un régimen para dar forma al follaje.

context.en: Harvest is based on visible head maturity; UMN's Minnesota season and field timing are not universal dates.
context.es: La cosecha depende de señales visibles de madurez de la cabeza; las fechas y temporadas de campo de UMN para Minnesota no son universales.

action.en: UMN recommends harvesting broccoli when the head reaches usable size while its buds remain tight and green. Cut the central head with a short stalk; leave the lower plant for side shoots and harvest those when usable. If flowers begin opening, harvest promptly because quality declines.
action.es: UMN recomienda cosechar cuando la cabeza alcanza un tamaño utilizable y los botones siguen cerrados y verdes. Corta la cabeza central con un tramo corto de tallo; deja la planta para que produzca brotes laterales y cosecha esos brotes cuando sean utilizables. Si las flores empiezan a abrirse, cosecha pronto porque la calidad disminuye.

context.en: UMN does not prescribe routine pruning; protecting the growing point and cutting the mature head above outer leaves is handling guidance.

action.en: The cited guide does not recommend routine pruning. Protect the growing point and outer leaves; harvest the mature head by cutting above the outer leaves rather than removing the plant's head-forming tissue early.
action.es: La guía citada no recomienda poda rutinaria. Protege el punto de crecimiento y las hojas exteriores; al madurar, corta la cabeza por encima de las hojas externas en vez de retirar temprano el tejido que forma la cabeza.

context.en: Firmness and density are harvest cues; Minnesota freeze timing and planting dates remain regional.

action.en: UMN recommends cutting Chinese/Napa cabbage when the head reaches usable size and feels firm and dense when pressed. Harvest promptly once mature because it can bolt and lose quality rather than holding in the garden like round cabbage. Minnesota freeze timing is regional.
action.es: UMN recomienda cortar la col china/napa cuando la cabeza alcance tamaño utilizable y se sienta firme y densa al presionarla. Cosecha pronto al madurar: puede espigarse y perder calidad en vez de mantenerse en el huerto como una col redonda. El calendario de heladas de Minnesota es regional.
